title: S&P Cotality Case-Shiller Home Price Indices (September 2026 data) — the edition that turns the December print from a two-step forecast into a one-step one
source: EST: derived from the publisher's own stated schedule rule, read direct from a primary today. press.spglobal.com's June-2026-data release (2026-08-25-S-P-Cotality-Case-Shiller-Index-Reports-Annual-Gain-in-June-2026), fetched direct 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200, 90,693 bytes), states it verbatim: `The S&P Cotality Case-Shiller Indices are published on the last Tuesday of each month at 9:00 am ET.` November 2026's Tuesdays are the 3rd, 10th, 17th and 24th, so the last is 2026-11-24, and the release's own two-month reporting lag puts September 2026 data on it. Independently corroborated on realized dates from prnewswire.com's Case-Shiller listing and per-item `datePublished` stamps, fetched direct 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200, 220,741 bytes): twelve consecutive realized editions 2025-09-30 through 2026-08-25, every one a last Tuesday — including 2025-11-25, the last Tuesday of November 2025. Filed `estimate` on the taxonomy gap (CONFIRMED_PREFIX in scripts/event-scan-validation.mjs has no member for a private index provider) and on this lane's no-self-confirm limit; the date is the publisher's own rule and is not in doubt. Discovered in the never-assessed initial research of case-shiller-hpi-2026-12-29, 2026-09-09
notes: PROPOSED 2026-09-09 by the case-shiller-hpi-2026-12-29 never-assessed initial research, at D-35 of its own print. WHY IT IS A GAP AND NOT BACKFILL, and the distinction is the one the case-shiller-hpi-2026-10-27 lane drew when it declined to propose a year of this series and proposed only its own immediate predecessor: this is the LAST edition before 2026-12-29, and the 2026-10-27 lane measured what that is worth in a number. Case-Shiller's national index is a three-month moving average at a two-month lag, so repeating the previous month's m/m forecasts the next print to a 0.119pp mean absolute error one step out against 0.201pp two steps out, on a series whose median monthly move is 0.312pp (FRED CSUSHPISA vs HPIPONM226S, 2015+, n=138, measured 2026-09-08). Until this edition lands, 2026-12-29 sits more than one step out and no October consensus can exist; once it lands, the December print is the single most forecastable macro release on this calendar. THE ASYMMETRY THAT MAKES IT A COVERAGE GAP RATHER THAN A PREFERENCE: fhfa-hpi-2026-11-24 and consumer-confidence-2026-11-24 are BOTH already tracked, and all three publishers key on the same last Tuesday — so the calendar currently sees two thirds of a house-price-and-confidence morning and not the third, exactly the shape of gap that put 2026-12-29 itself on the board. NOT PROPOSED, AND THE REASON IS RECORDED: the successor edition, 2026-11-data on 2027-01-26, is equally derivable from the same rule and is equally missing, but a successor changes nothing about this event's uncertainty while a predecessor halves it; proposing both would be the backfill the 10-27 lane declined.
